$originalPi = ((& git ls-tree $target original-pi) -split '\s+')[2]
$goldBand = ((& git ls-tree $target gold-band) -split '\s+')[2]
$worktree = @(& git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)
$upstream = & git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name '@{upstream}' 2>$null

$remoteRefs = @(& git ls-remote origin)

  -or $manifest.repository.parent -ne $parent -or $worktreeDiffExit -ne 0 -or $commitDiffExit -ne 0
if ($failed) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $evidence; exit 1 }
Add-Content -LiteralPath $evidence -Value 'INDEPENDENT_FINAL_REPOSITORY_CHECKS_OK'
Get-Content -LiteralPath $evidence
